The background shows the metal truss framework of the hangar ceiling and some indistinct ground-level structures.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text artifact on the side of the blimp. While the overall shape is correct, AI models often fail at rendering coherent text on curved surfaces. Verify if the text is merely blurry due to resolution or if it exhibits structural melting/fusion characteristic of generation artifacts. Also, check if the hangar beams in the background maintain consistent perspective lines or if they warp near the airship.
